name: IPDL_v2
description: Projet de classe initialement réalisé en groupe en classe avec des codes donnes par le prof avec GitLab comme dépôt distant, SénSanté Pro est repris de ma propre initiative et développé individuellement sur GitHub pour renforcer mes compétences en Spring Boot. J’y apporte des améliorations full-stack avec React, PostgreSQL, IA, Docker et Terraform.

name: APACHE_AIRFLOW_WORKS
description: NYC Taxi Data Pipeline built with Apache Airflow for the DataTalksClub Data Engineering Zoomcamp. Adapted from Kestra + GCP to Airflow + Oracle Cloud (Object Storage + ADW). Full ELT: extract 40M+ NYC taxi rows, upload to OCI, transform via staging tables, and merge with MD5 deduplication into Oracle ADW.

name: MIT_WEEK6_Neural_Network_I
description: Solutions and notes for Week 6 (Neural Networks I) of MITx 6.036, including the homework notebook, Python implementations, understanding concepts behind Neural Networks.

name: MIT_WEEK7_Neural_Network_II
description: Solutions and notes for Week 7 (Neural Networks II) of MITx 6.036, including the homework notebook, Python implementations of Linear, Tanh, ReLU and SoftMax layers, NLL loss, SGD training routines, reproducible examples, and notes on optimization, regularization, and dropout.

name: LeagueScore
description: Football live-score app vibe-coded for the AI Dev Tools Zoomcamp 2026. Full-stack with React 19, TypeScript, FastAPI, and SQLAlchemy. Includes live scores, match center, league standings, admin console, and real-time sync via API-Football. Built with AI-assisted engineering

name: Customer-Support-Agent
description: Projet d’apprentissage réalisé avec Cognitive Class : création d’un agent de support client avec PydanticAI et Pydantic. Le projet explore les agents IA, la validation des sorties structurées, les prompts few-shot, l’analyse de tickets et le traitement asynchrone en Python. Code basé sur un laboratoire guidé.

name: langchain4j-quickstart
description: Chatbot terminal en Java avec LangChain4j et Moonshot AI (Kimi K3). Premier projet du cours LangChain4j — Du zero au hero. Apprends a integrer un LLM dans une application Java.

name: Homework-1-Introduction-to-Machine-Learning
description: First homework for Machine Learning Zoomcamp 2026 (DataTalks Club). Explores Pandas & NumPy fundamentals: data exploration, missing value imputation, and linear algebra with a vehicle fuel efficiency dataset (10K records).

name: Homework-2-Machine-Learning-for-Regression
description: Homework 2 of the Machine Learning Zoomcamp 2026 (DataTalks Club). Build a linear regression model to predict car fuel efficiency (MPG). Covers missing value imputation, Ridge regularization, seed sensitivity analysis, and train/val/test splitting strategies on a 10K vehicle dataset.

name: Google-DeepMind-AI-Research-Foundations-solutions
description: Coursework, lab solutions, and research notes from the full Google DeepMind AI Research Foundations learning path.

name: NeuralPulse
description: Pipeline automatisé de digest d'actualités IA. Scrape 12 sources majeures (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, Mistral...) chaque samedi, déduplique, résume via Groq LLM (qwen3.8-27b) avec un commentaire pédagogique en français, et livre un digest hebdomadaire sur Telegram et sur Slack. Spring Boot 3.3, déployé sur Oracle Cloud.

name: SCALA-BANK
description: A learning project. I'm building a command-line banking system in Scala 3 to actually apply what I learn in class — case classes, pattern matching, Either, enums, for comprehensions. Everything is immutable, everything is functional.

name: TECHBLOCKS
description: Documentation collaborative orientée développeurs — éditeur de blocs (Markdown, Code, Mermaid, API, Callout), autosave, historique de révisions, JWT. React 19 · Spring Boot 3.5 · PostgreSQL 16. 100% vibe coded — projet d'application des certifs Google AI (Coursera) et Claude Code in Action (Anthropic).

name: tontine-pilot
description: AI copilot for community tontines — AWS Zero to Shipped hackathon in the AWS Skills Builder Center.

name: Aether-Archive
description: A local-first, mobile-first digital sanctuary for aesthetic photos and monthly 6-picture dumps. Spring Boot + React + SQLite, Dark Glassmorphism, zero external requests.
